{{Top|leg}}
The '''Jalorian Sodality''' was a region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] in the [[Corridan sector/Legends|Corridan sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].

During the final years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] directed a [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] operation to intercept a shipment of [[fire emerald]]s from the Solidarity, but was unable to recover the [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstones]] before the shipment was consumed by the [[Khadaji Singularity/Legends|Khadaji Singularity]].
